regions.region: page 1 title, author/checker block, and reaction scheme
regions.finding: The source-derived title is Buta-2,3-dien-1-ol. The single scheme shows propargyl alcohol plus paraformaldehyde/iPr2NH/CuI in refluxing THF to the allenol; it is the summary of the detailed procedure, not a separate experiment.

Beginning of one main 0.40 mol preparation: exact CuI, paraformaldehyde, THF, diisopropylamine, and propargyl-alcohol charges, ordered addition, open-to-air apparatus, sticky-mixture warning, and rapid 21→27 °C exotherm were structured. The procedure continues on page 2.

unresolved: The second run is only stated later as being on the same scale; page 1 does not independently print its charges.

regions.region: page 2 Figure 1 and continuation of Procedure
regions.finding: Figure 1 is a reaction-appearance photograph at reflux initiation, not another reaction. The same mixture is held at 66 °C reflux for 24 h without inert atmosphere, cooled to room temperature, transferred, and rotary-evaporated at 20 °C/75 mmHg.

unresolved: Cooling duration and rotary-evaporation duration are not reported.
Approximately 720 mL removed is supplied only by Note 7 text on page 7 and is logged as context, not as page-7 coverage.

regions.finding: Photograph of the same reaction after 24 h under reflux; it documents the reddish-brown appearance and is not a separate experiment.
A 2 °C solution of Et2O (500 mL)/12 N HCl (50 mL) is cooled to ca. −10 °C; ca. 185 g concentrated reaction solution is added in five portions ca. 3 min apart. The exotherm continues onto page 4.

unresolved: Cooling-transition and total addition times are not printed; the five 3-min-spaced portions were not arithmetically collapsed into a fabricated total.
12 N is retained as the source concentration string because it is not a supported normalized quantity unit.

regions.region: page 4 upper continuation of acidic quench
regions.finding: The portionwise quench reaches a maximum of 4.0 °C, then the mixture settles 5 min and the yellow supernatant is decanted through 50 g silica gel with brief vacuum.
Photograph of the yellow solution after initial filtration; appearance evidence only, not a separate experiment.
Residue is extracted with 100 mL Et2O, mechanically stirred 3 min, settled 3 min, and the supernatant is decanted to the same silica pad; repetition continues on page 5.

unresolved: The source gives only a brief-vacuum operation, not a filtration pressure or duration.
Silica gel has no unique molecular structure and remains structure-null.

regions.finding: The 100 mL Et2O extraction/settling/decantation/filtration cycle is repeated twice more (three total); Figure 4 shows the silica pad after all filtrations and does not define another experiment.

regions.region: page 5 lower workup and concentration paragraph
regions.finding: Approximately 850 mL filtrate is washed with saturated NaCl (2×100 mL), aqueous phases are back-extracted with Et2O (2×100 mL), organics are dried over 40 g Na2SO4, concentrated at 20 °C/65 mmHg with ca. 820 mL removed, and transferred with ~50 mL MTBE; the final concentration continues on page 6.

unresolved: Workup operation times are not reported.
The second run is linked only by the later same-scale statement; page 5 does not independently describe it.

regions.region: page 6 upper concentration and short-path distillation
regions.finding: Further concentration at 20 °C/65 mmHg gives 23.5 g crude oil. A −78 °C receiver is used for a 2.0 mL forerun collected at 45 °C, followed by a −78 °C 25-mL receiver for the 12.5 g, 45%, 98%-purity main fraction at pot 65 °C and 55 °C/30–33 mmHg. Note 12 points to a distinct same-scale second run (12.8 g, 46%) stated on page-7 text; page 7 is context only, not covered.

Glassware drying, material purities, the optimized 1.6-equiv paraformaldehyde/1.4-equiv diisopropylamine ratio, rapid-stirring requirement, and color change were associated with the same main procedure, not new optimization rows because no distinct run outcomes are printed here.

GC showed complete consumption of propargyl alcohol after 24 h. The DB-1701 program, detector/injector temperatures, flow, and reactant/product retention times were retained as the conversion measurement basis, not as a separate synthetic experiment.

unresolved: Distillation stage durations are not reported.
The second run has no run-specific operational details beyond same scale, 12.8 g, and 46%.
The second-run purity was not independently stated.
Page 7 original image was not inspected and is not claimed as covered.
